build_resnetv2_symbol: build a ResNetV2 MXNet symbol with softmax output for a given number of classes and depth
build_resnetv2_linear: build a ResNetV2 MXNet symbol with a linear classifier layer for image classification
build_resnetv2_before_pool: build a ResNetV2 feature extractor symbol up to the global pooling layer
review_resenet_spec: review the ResNetV2 depth specification dictionary mapping depths to stage block counts
test_resnetv2_symbol: test the ResNetV2 symbol generation by saving to JSON and printing a network summary
